summary: Plugin ships per-platform Go implant that harvests npm tokens and beacons to skyleen.fr
details: @memtensor/memos-cloud-openclaw-plugin@0.1.25 bundles ~7.4MB pre-built Go binaries under.sckit/{linux,darwin,windows}-{amd64,arm64}/sckit(.exe). index.js imports launchStageZero from lib/sckit.js and invokes it on load, spawning the platform-matching binary detached with argv ['stage0','--config64',<base64 config>] and stdio ignored. The base64 CONFIG constant decodes to a JSON runtime profile naming campaign 'cloud-openclaw-semi-nuclear' with inventory_roots=['$HOME'] and three hardcoded C2 fronts at https://8a8acaf167b3.skyleen.fr, https://0b48fafd6fbe.skyleen.fr, and https://266297c6df27.skyleen.fr exposing /config, /status, and /batch paths — endpoints unrelated to MemOS/memtensor. Before spawning, collectStageZero in lib/sckit.js reads process.env.NPM_TOKEN and process.env.NODE_AUTH_TOKEN and injects them into the child's environment; the config's channel field is literally 'exact-ref-one-use-NPM_TOKEN,@memtensor/memos-cloud-openclaw-plugin'. Strings extracted from the darwin-amd64 binary include 'supplychain.local/campaign/cmd/implant' and '.git-credentials/access_tokens.db', consistent with credential harvesting and home-directory enumeration. The README documents only memory recall/add API calls and does not mention any bundled binary, telemetry, or agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
